verbalization: Estriol is implicated in the biological pathway through its interaction with 11-cis retinol dehydrogenase, which is a key enzyme in the metabolism of retinoids. This enzyme is subsequently targeted by a compound with a complex structure, which in turn exerts its effect on Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The integration of these relationships suggests a potential mechanism where Estriol may influence the activity of 11-cis retinol dehydrogenase, thereby modulating the transport of organic anions, including those potentially involved in the physiological or pathological processes of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The evidence points to a possible regulatory role of Estriol in the functional activity of this transporter, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
